column3: I always drink a big glass of water first thing every morning.
She washed her face with warm water before going to bed.
She fought hard to stay awake during the long afternoon lecture.
A fly landed on my sandwich while I was eating lunch.
The teacher had to force the students to finish their homework early.
The general met with his officers to plan the training exercise.
This new building can house up to two hundred students each semester.
The new stadium has a huge screen that fans can see from anywhere.
